motivation: RAER v1 reduced harmful actions and validation cost relative to FIXED_0.20 on validation but failed its safe-completion constraint because a hard residual-risk threshold caused unnecessary abstention.
research_contribution: An abstention-aware, authorization-sensitive, budgeted evidence-revalidation objective with controlled budget-boundary slack.

unchanged_components.invalidity_estimator: E0 fixed monotone logistic estimator from the frozen v1 calibration
unchanged_components.subset_solver: exact enumeration with deterministic tie breaking

expected_loss_objective.valid_check_branch: For candidate subset S, set q_i'=0.01 for i in S and q_i'=q_i otherwise.
expected_loss_objective.residual_harm: R(S)=h*[1-product_i(1-q_i'*w_i)]+the frozen correlated-prerequisite uplift, capped at h.
expected_loss_objective.safe_probability_proxy: P_safe(S)=product_i(1-q_i'). This is a pre-outcome model quantity, not an observed label.
expected_loss_objective.selection: Choose the feasible subset minimizing J; ties are resolved by lower total cost, lower residual harm, fewer checks, then lexicographic evidence IDs.
expected_loss_objective.observed_invalid_check: If any selected prerequisite is invalid, ASK when any detected invalid item is authorization evidence; otherwise REFRESH. This overrides the planned ACT/ABSTAIN decision.

budget_rule.interpretation: The 0.05 allowance addresses fractional boundary mismatch only; it does not permit the cost of another full K unit.

authorization_safeguard.trigger: authorization sensitivity S>=4 and q_i*w_i>=theta_auth for an authorization prerequisite
authorization_safeguard.required_behavior: Every triggered authorization prerequisite must be included in S.
authorization_safeguard.infeasible_behavior: If the required authorization set cannot fit within B+delta, the policy must ABSTAIN; it may not silently omit the safeguard.
authorization_safeguard.gate_metric: harmful actions caused by an unchecked triggered authorization prerequisite

safe_completion_constraint.level: aggregate out-of-fold design gate, not case-label access during evidence selection
safe_completion_constraint.rule: RAER v2 safe completion on all-valid cases must be within 0.05 of the best registered comparator.
safe_completion_constraint.selection_eligibility: A configuration is eligible on inner design data only when it satisfies the safe-completion rule, has harmful-action rate no worse than FIXED_0.20, has zero triggered-authorization harmful actions, positive-slack use rate <=0.25, mean slack <=0.025, and maximum slack <=0.05.

prohibitions: No held-out labels during formulation, implementation, design selection, or design gate analysis
No alteration of v1 case text, labels, reviewer scores, or partitions
No post-result expansion of the candidate grid
No relabelling of the exposed 72 cases as confirmatory evidence
